title: Bound two early encodings for owned 1548
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7481, test deleting owned1548’s rank-one MOVE39785 and its two recipient writes. Add the historical value u to roles 1197 and 1358 with arbitrary rational coefficients at their old chart-529 departures. Advance the named already-paid arrivals and offer the two encoded rows with fixed donors 913, 587 and 1494 before ADD46664.

Three exact input probes annihilate the fixed bank and give determinant −2 on the two original carrier rows and u. No combination of the two encoded carriers can supply the required correction at the first deadline, even granting both later restorations. One case exhausted with zero unresolved in scope. Other carrier sets, writable banks, timing and signed retirement remain open.

The gross recurrence price is 17 raw across 17 signed calls, before other charges. The proposed stationary lifetime raises the live owner peak from 50 to 51. One additional rank-one call per copy consumes the gross. No complete candidate advanced.

## Exact sources and replay

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Exact #7481 at 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b and signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate ancestor commits.

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-owned1548-early-encoding-bound/replay.py
```

Expect `PASS_OWNED1548_EARLY_ENCODING_BOUND`. The exact quotient and independent normalized forward replay took 0.15 s and 0.70 s under their 30-second caps. Direct, registered, read-only Git-free export, exact source/history/mode checks and all 27 local onboarding tests passed. Signed physical and full application replay were outside this exclusion.

## Credit and open questions

#7537 supplies the same-site fixed-donor predecessor. #7481/#7480/#7334 supply the native lineage, #7113 the signed caller, #7482 exact cut rows, #7522 the integer engine, #7500 a separate chart-127 repair precedent and #7508 the exact public input bytes. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent verification and packaging.

A changed carrier must pass the three exact probes at the first deadline and preserve its own independent output before a build is justified.
